revealWordProblem.title: Apply: Snack Bags
revealWordProblem.text:
The student council buys snacks in bulk to sell during lunch. One box holds the snacks shown: 20 bags of cheese crackers and 25 bags of pretzels. In the first month the council sold 115 bags of snacks, including 50 bags of cheese crackers.
Question: How many boxes of snacks would you recommend the student council order for next month?
revealWordProblem.imageAlt: A bag of cheese crackers labeled 20 bags per box and a bag of pretzels labeled 25 bags per box.
revealWordProblem.sampleAnswer: One box holds 20 + 25 = 45 bags. To cover 115 bags, solve 45b = 115, so b = 115 ÷ 45 ≈ 2.6 boxes — boxes come whole, so 3 boxes. Now check the cheese crackers on their own: 50 sold, and 20b = 50 gives b = 2.5, so 3 boxes covers the crackers too (3 × 20 = 60). Three boxes gives 60 crackers and 75 pretzels — plenty of crackers, and more pretzels than the 65 that sold. I would recommend 3 boxes, and would ask the supplier about ordering crackers separately, since crackers sell faster than the box ratio supplies them.

reviewCheck.stem: A detective splits 54 clues equally among 9 case files. The equation 9c = 54 represents this. What is c?
reviewCheck.explanation: Divide both sides by 9: c = 54 ÷ 9 = 6 clues per file.
choiceFeedback: Not quite. Divide both sides by 9: c = 54 ÷ 9 = ___ clues per file.
That is 54 − 9. Sharing equally is a division, so undo the multiplication by dividing.
That is the number of case files, not the number of clues in each one. Divide the total by the number of files.
hints: c is the number of clues in EACH file, and 9 files with c clues each make all 54 clues.
9c = 54 multiplies c by 9 — undo it by dividing both sides by 9, not by adding or subtracting.
Compute 54 ÷ 9 (what times 9 makes 54?). Your answer should be much smaller than 54 — clues per file, not the total.
reviewCheck.stemEs: Un detective reparte 54 pistas en partes iguales entre 9 expedientes. La ecuación 9c = 54 representa esta situación. ¿Cuánto vale c?
reviewCheck.explanationEs: Divide ambos lados entre 9: c = 54 ÷ 9 = 6 pistas por expediente.
hintsEs: c es el número de pistas en CADA archivo, y 9 archivos con c pistas cada uno forman las 54 pistas.
9c = 54 multiplica c por 9: deshazlo dividiendo ambos lados entre 9, no sumando ni restando.
Calcula 54 ÷ 9 (¿qué por 9 da 54?). Tu respuesta debe ser mucho menor que 54: son pistas por archivo, no el total.
